title.narrative: Farming Enterprises and Employment for Disabled People (FEED)

description.narrative: PWDs typically are the least likely to be able to access employment because they experience multiple disadvantages across sectors. This project aims to create tangible, sustainable agricultural employment and livelihoods for PWDs through the development of commercially viable farming enterprises and a linked out-growers exchange programme in Zambia innovatively managed by and for PWDs. The purpose of this application is to equip and build the capacity of an Agri-Business Unit with ZAFOD to manage and develop the project and provide on-going expertise to develop and grow other agri-business models beyond the life of this project. Results: ? significant increase in the economic activity of over 400 PWDs in FEED enterprises (this number expanding over life of project); ? enhanced livelihoods for over 100 PWDs and their families as FEED out-growers (potentially expanding to 1,000 over life of project); ? heightened public awareness of the capacity of PWDs to engage in economic activity; ? a simple sustainable public private partnership managed locally by PWDs that allows for rapid replication and mainstreaming within Zambia and in other countries; ? enhanced capacity of ZAFOD through the development of an Agri-Business Unit. ? secure funding streams for the two main project promoters – ZAFOD and ZAPD – for re-investment in other disability support programmes
